RAMYA PAVANI Email: ramyapavani1402@gmail.com

Phone: 9440254570 ● Over 5.9 Years of experience in Software development. ● Certified Anaplan Model Builder with Intensive experience of 3.5 years as Anaplan Model Builder. ● Well experienced in end-to-end implementation of Anaplan Models, Modules, Dashboard, workflow, Lists, Actions. ● Have Experienced with Integration concepts between various Models and working Knowledge of Anaplan Connect. ● Experienced in Coordinating with onsite team members and development team. ● Experience in responding to Request for Proposals (RFPs) and good experience in Anaplan Modeling, requirement gathering, solution design, build, Unit testing, debugging and Performance tuning with the industry best standards. ● Ability to meet deadlines and handle multiple tasks in a pressured environment, proficient in report writing, decisive with strong leadership qualities, flexible in work schedules. ● Versatile team player with excellent analytical, presentation and interpersonal skills with an aptitude to learn new technologies • Anaplan: Lists, Modules, Dashboards, Actions, Processes, Imports, User Role and Access Setup • Operating Systems: Windows 7/8/10, UNIX, Linux ● Bachelor of Science from Rai Technology University Bengaluru Karnataka . • Anaplan Level 1 Model Builder • Anaplan Level 2 Model Builder. • Anaplan Level 3 Model Builder

ProfessionalSummary

TechnicalSkills:

Education:

CERTIFICATIONS:

WORK EXPERIENCE: • worked as Anaplan Developer with Cognizant Technology Solutions from Sep 2024 to Nov 2025. • Worked as Anaplan Developer with Wipro Limited from Oct 2022 to June 2024 • Worked as Test Engineer with Brightcom Groups April 2019 to Oct 2021.

PROJECT EXPERIENCE:

Project 1: CAPEX

Planning Role: Anaplan Developer Team Size: 8 Responsibilities: • Requirement Gathering from key stakeholders to enhance the prebuilt model. • Build model including lists, versions, time, modules, and dashboards using Anaplan best practices and optimize the model. • Created new model for EXIT Outlet users. • Worked on ALM for model and App both. • Developed business logics in Anaplan to meet users’ expectations. • Designed Exit Outlet model from scratch for outlet users. • User Training, Documentation, UAT support. • Plan, prepare and execute the unit testing. Prepared the test cases for User Acceptance Testing.

Project 2: Financial Planning and Analysis Role: Anaplan Developer Team Size: 6 Responsibilities: • Performed model building tasks on Revenue forecasting, P&L Reporting, among other models. • Experienced in coordinating with the Onsite Team members for optimizing the Business Scenario and accomplish the Project Goals. • Created Dashboards for User-Friendly Experience.

Prepared process document, user manuals and training guide for users. • Participate in unit testing and coordinated UAT for the end users. • Attending daily review meeting to solve issues, understand requirements and changes needed • Expert in using Application Lifecycle Management to manage the Development, Testing & Deployment of our Model. • Practiced Anaplan Agile Methodology for planning and execution on project deliverables from requirements. Project 3: Sales Planning Role: Anaplan Developer Team Size: 6 Responsibilities: • Translated the Business requirements to enterprise models with associated modules, lists/line items, • and calculations as supported by multi-dimensional Anaplan platform. • Developed several Dashboards like Operational & Reporting Dashboards for better understanding. • Experienced in coordinating with the Onsite Team members for optimizing the Business Scenario and accomplish the Project Goals. • Expert in using Application Lifecycle Management to manage the Development, Testing & Deployment of our Model. • Practiced Anaplan Agile Methodology for planning and execution on project deliverables from requirements.
